names.ja: フィカス・ベンジャミナ

light.best.quote: This ficus performs best in bright indirect sunny locations

light.min.quote: but will also survive in shade

light.min.reason: 日陰でも枯れはしないとされるが、葉を落としやすいため「やや明るい」までとした

light.directSun.quote: They will handle some direct sun if the humidity is high.

temperature.minC.quote: It is intolerant to cold and should be kept away from drafts.

temperature.minC.reason: 出典に最低温度の記載がないため、熱帯原産の観葉植物の一般的な安全域として10℃とした

temperature.idealC.quote: Night temperatures of 65 to 70 °F and day temperatures of 75 to 85 °F are ideal.

humidity.quote: Weeping figs prefer high humidity levels.

watering.growing.quote: During periods of active growth, keep the soil evenly moist.
Water just often enough to keep the soil from completely drying out.

watering.winter.quote: The soil should be allowed to dry slightly between waterings during the winter and other times of low growth.

tips.ja: 光にとても敏感で、置き場所を変えると葉を落としてから新しい環境に合った葉を出す。
tips.quote: It is very sensitive to light, so if the plant is moved, it may drop leaves and produce new ones that are accustomed to the new light conditions.

tips.ja: いちばん多いトラブルは落葉。水のやりすぎ・不足、すきま風、窒素不足、光不足のどれでも葉を落とす。
tips.quote: Overwatering, under-watering, drafts, lack of nitrogen, and low light are all causes of leaf drop.

tips.ja: 植え替えや置き場所の移動のあとにも葉を落としやすい。
tips.quote: Weeping figs often shed leaves when moved to a new location or repotted.
